Sect. 5 discusses the evaluation, outcomes, and performance analysis of the experiments 
conducted to test the proposed framework. Section  6 presents the findings and com -
pares the proposed framework with the existing works. The conclusion is presented in 
Sect. 7.
2 Related works
This section presents the literature on the opportunities and challenges of implement -
ing technological advancements in Smart healthcare systems. Some of the best research 
works published in medical fields are highlighted here.
Zheng et al. [17] proposed an IPFS-based Blockchain system to reduce the data storage 
in Blockchain networks and increase processing speed. They implemented this scheme 
on the Bitcoin Blockchain. A zigzag-based novel storage model is proposed by Chen et 
al. [18] to increase the block storage model. High throughput is achieved in this model 
with the implementation of IPFS. Pan et al. [ 19] proposed an edge-IoT framework, 
EdgeChain, based on Blockchain and smart contracts for secure and scalable commu -
nication. Jolfaei et al. [ 9] discuss different system models and how to improve the scal -
ability of Blockchain-based systems. Off-chain and on-chain-based models can be used 
to overcome the scalability issues in Blockchain-based IoMT systems. Providing a clear 
route for tracing the activities and achieving a high level of trustworthiness, Nyaletey 
et al. [20] proposed block IPFS a Blockchain-enabled IPFS. For secure storage, safe data 
sharing, and maintaining security while working in the system, Li et al. [ 21] proposed a 
hyperledger fabric and Interplanetary File System to safely share healthcare information. 
On-chain and off-chain Blockchain-based Interplanetary File system solves scalability, 
confidentiality, and storage problems. This model increases the confidentiality of shar -
ing healthcare information proposed by Mani et al. [ 22]. A Blockchain-based Interplan -
etary File System is proposed by Mamun et al. [ 23] for implementing Blockchain EMR 
and providing access rules. An immutable Blockchain-based Interplanetary File System 
is proposed by Sultana et al. [ 24] for enhancing the security of healthcare data transac -
tions. For easy access, consistency, integrity, availability, and security, Kumar et al. [ 25] 
proposed off-chain data storage. Interplanetary File System uses blockchain technology 
in its model. Alrebdi et al. [ 26] proposed a Blockchain smart contract-based decentral -
ized medical record system with several features: immutability, anonymity, security, 
decentralized, and tamper-proof. Interplanetary File Systems and cloud computing 
technology are used here for medical record-keeping. A security and privacy protection 
scheme using Blockchain technology is proposed by Tan et al. [ 27] with traceable and 
direct revocation for COVID-19 records. Cipher text policy attribute-based encryption 
is used here. Distributed patient-centric image management (PCIM) system, an Ethe -
reum Blockchain, and an Interplanetary File System (IPFS) are proposed by Jabarulla 
et al. [ 28] for decentralized storage and global access to medical images. A systematic 
review of Blockchain-based PHRs has been done by Fang et al. [ 11] for limitations, 
design choices, and future direction. The attribute-based encryption scheme is proposed 
by Sun et al. [ 29] for the storage and sharing of medical records using Blockchain tech -
nology and the Interplanetary File System.

resposta.resumo: O trecho descreve a seção de avaliação e resultados do trabalho, apresenta um panorama de trabalhos relacionados que utilizam IPFS, blockchain e técnicas de criptografia para melhorar a escalabilidade, confidencialidade e segurança em sistemas de saúde inteligentes. São citados diversos estudos que combinam armazenamento off‑chain, contratos inteligentes, edge‑IoT e criptografia baseada em atributos para superar limitações de desempenho e privacidade.

resposta.interpretacao: O trabalho se alinha a uma tendência de combinar IPFS com blockchain para mitigar problemas de escalabilidade e ponto único de falha, reforçando a segurança e a eficiência na troca de dados de saúde, e posiciona-se dentro de um cenário de múltiplas propostas semelhantes que exploram off‑chain storage e criptografia avançada.
